summary.text: Daniel Rhyne is the Republican candidate for Illinois State Senate District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Christopher Belt. A U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he works as a mechanic and union treasurer.

paragraphs.text: Rhyne was born in Belleville, Illinois, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1992 to 2000.
He earned an associate degree from Southwestern Illinois College in 2007.

His career experience includes working as a mechanic and union treasurer, and he has been affiliated with United Steelworkers Local 1899, Veterans of Steel, the American Legion and Disabled American Veterans.
Rhyne won the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a "Marine Veteran/Commonsense Republican" and listed lowering taxes and easing regulations, ending cashless bail, and ending sanctuary policies among his key messages.
